description: This file defines a class 'FormatWithProject' that implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface. The class's purpose is to format a value by retrieving and returning the name of a Project entity based on an ID, using injected project services. It is part of the OrangeHRM Maintenance plugin for access strategy formatting.

classes.name: FormatWithProject
classes.description: A class that formats a project ID to the corresponding project name by accessing the project service.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the project by ID and returns its name if available, otherwise returns null.
